profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Analyze and solve complex software problems. Current with cutting edge technology. Self-starter. Goal-oriented. Work well on teams or individually. Always produce high quality, self-tested, and fully documented software.

DevOps | Agile Software Methodology | Problem Analysis & Resolution Test Driven Development | Process Improvement | Requirements Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming languages: C#, C++, SQL, Java.
Development environments: Visual Studio, Eclipse, Android Studio.
Application platforms: .Net Core/Framework, Android, Qt, X11.
Version control platforms: GitHub, Perforce.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Portfolio Management Team. Designed and implemented solutions to improve automated prescription delivery. Continuously created documentation to improve knowledge sharing. Collaborated with colleagues following Agile development methodology while working remotely.
• Lead Software Engineer to implement and deploy Integrated Manifesting at a customer’s Central Fill location. Integrated Manifesting allows customers to weigh and measure packages right at the point of packing. This change along, with an addition of a new packing station, relieved a bottleneck source, which led to a substantial increase in the throughput of daily orders.
• Designed and implemented the software solution to efficiently manage inventory in a Central Fill location to have a single source of medicine purchasing to be dispensed both in a standard vial or in the new pill pack dispensers. This solution provided a way for drug purchasing managers to have a better understanding of the purchasing requirements of a medicine and preventing rejection of prescriptions due to incorrect or insufficient allocation of medicine.
• Created the training program associated with bringing new employees up to speed on our latest software solutions and thereby facilitating their transition from training to contributors in a period of two weeks. This training included a schedule, detailed documentation, and videos that were highly praised by all the engineers that went through this material. The financial and productive impact of this effort was incredibly high because it allowed new employees to acquire all the information needed to start working on new deliverables in a very short period.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Supported emergent customer issues arriving from any of our 30+ customer locations associated with Central Fill Prescription Delivery Automation. Issues included, but where not limited to, database errors, software bugs, hardware failures, and incorrect usage of features by users. These events taught me to be calm and professional, to ask questions beyond what is provided by the customer in order to efficiently identify the source of problems.
• Configured and simulated customer environments in both virtual and local environments to develop new software as well as fixing issues reported by customers. Although simulated Central Fill environments was not new when I joined McKesson, it often relied on using specific machines that had all the applications installed. The new solution involved a cloud repository of customer environments that allow an engineer to recreate any existing deployment by simply dropping the customer executables in the appropriate places. Not only were the engineers able to replicate the systems, but they could also generate orders specific for those customers, significantly reducing time associated with completing tasks.
• Managed the Quality and Test development and deployment of new software using DevOps to create features that were self-tested during every iteration of the product. Tests included Unit Tests, Integrated Tests, and User Interface Tests. The infrastructure allowed developers to use virtual environments to develop and test their features and check the tests that had been created for those features. I frequently served as an intermediary between product owners and developers to create concise test suites that served both parties’ objectives. Once the features were completed, I oversaw the process of reviewing all features to ensure that they had been implemented correctly, before deploying those features for the product owners to review.

patents.title: Preview and modification of printable components of a document at a printing device
patents.description: An apparatus, method, system and medium are described that support functionality to receive document(s) to be printed at a printing device, and enable editing the document(s) prior to printing. Modifications to the document(s) may be generated based on the user edits, and a print preview of the modified documents may be displayed and may enable further edits. In some embodiments, the print preview may be provided to the user on a display that is part of the printing device. In some embodiments, the print preview may be provided to the user through a UI presented on a client device. Display of the modified document(s) may be a rasterized image of the modified document(s), generated based on capabilities of a selected printing device. In some embodiments, modifications may be made to an intermediate version of the document(s), and that intermediate version may be cached.
